Purpose: Reference for AI agents working on Rusty Commit codebase. Project: Rusty Commit (`rco`) (AI-powered commit message generator in Rust). Repo: https://github.com/hongkongkiwi/rusty-commit. Version: 1.0.24 | Last Updated: 2026-02-02. Binary: `rco` (also `rusty-commit`). Code size: ~15,500 lines across 58 source files. Architecture: Trait-based provider system, async/await with tokio. Key deps: tokio 1.35, clap 4.5, git2 0.20, async-openai 0.32, rmcp 0.13.

Procedural commands/tools/file paths (verbatim): `git push`, `git reset --hard`, `git clean -fd`; `rm -rf` or deleting files outside project dir; Modifying system files or installing system packages; `cargo test`; `cargo test --all-features`; `cargo test test_name`; `cargo test -- --nocapture  # With output`; `cargo build --release`; `cargo build --all-features`; `cargo build --features secure-storage`; `cargo build --no-default-features --features openai  # Minimal`; `just build     # via justfile`; `just all       # fmt + clippy + test`; `RUST_BACKTRACE=1 cargo test -- --nocapture`; `RUST_LOG=debug rco ...`; `rco auth login` or set `RCO_API_KEY`; Check `.git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg` is executable; Location files: `~/.config/rustycommit/config.{toml,json}`, `.rustycommit.toml`, `.rco.toml`. Provider creation steps: 1. Create `src/providers/newprovider.rs` 2. Implement `AIProvider` trait 3. Add to factory in `src/providers/mod.rs` 4. Add feature flag in `Cargo.toml` 5. Add tests in `tests/`.

Safety rules (verbatim): `git push`, `git reset --hard`, `git clean -fd` ; `rm -rf` or deleting files outside project dir ; Modifying system files or installing system packages ; **Nev
